records.name: Gray Swan Arena
records.focus: Indirect-prompt-injection robustness across tool-use, coding, and computer-use agents.
records.focusZh: 评估工具调用、编程与计算机操作智能体对间接提示注入的鲁棒性。
records.verificationNote: Gray Swan's official March 2026 IPI Arena results report attack success rates across 13 frontier models. Lower is better. The three lowest published rates are reproduced here; the Arena link opens the live Gray Swan application.

records.name: CyberGym
records.focus: Agents reproduce real-world vulnerabilities by generating working proofs of concept.
records.focusZh: 让智能体通过生成可运行的概念验证程序，复现真实世界漏洞。
records.verificationNote: CyberGym's official Level 1 leaderboard sorts submissions by score_10 and labels it Success Rate: the percentage of instances where an agent reproduces the target vulnerability with a working proof of concept.

records.name: ExploitGym
records.focus: Agents generate end-to-end exploits across userspace, browser V8, and the Linux kernel.
records.focusZh: 评估智能体在用户态、浏览器 V8 与 Linux 内核中生成端到端漏洞利用的能力。
records.verificationNote: ExploitGym's official leaderboard sorts by on_target: instances exploited through the intended vulnerability. Evaluation timeouts are retained on each row because the leading submission uses a longer budget.
